name: 53179 · Trevor, WI
findings: ZIP 53179 (Trevor) has 7 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (86%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53179 (Trevor) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53179 (Trevor) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
